note: What players report, by level, in our own words. Map stats on the page come from the game data and update daily; these notes are re-checked against the community every week.

tips: Do every Maple Island quest first. You leave around level 8 with free potions and a chair.
Warriors can basic attack all the way here and spend almost nothing on potions.

picks.why: Ribbon Pigs, usually quiet.
The Slime tree north of Ellinia. Packed and safe.
Slimes and mushrooms next to Henesys.

tips: Pick maps where you kill in one or two hits; extra hits are where potions go.

picks.map: Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North IV
picks.why: Green Mushrooms and Slimes in the Ellinia tree dungeons. Players report coming out meso positive.
Octopus near Kerning City.

tips: Stay off Dangerous Croko I and II: level 52 Crocos walk through them.

picks.why: Bubblings under Kerning City. Dense and flat, but they hit hard: go once you kill in 1 or 2 hits.
Stirges from about 20, for magicians, thieves and bowmen. Warriors usually skip Stirges. Crowded.
More Stirges, same advice.
Jr. Neckis from 21, called the safest Necki map. A common pick for mesos and EXP until 30 to 35.

tips: Kerning PQ (21+, party of 4) is fun, but most guides say party grinding gives more EXP: about half a level a run at 21 to 22.
Iron Hogs: 500 physical defense, so physical attacks do about a sixth of normal damage. Mages with lightning do best.
Melee profit in the Ant Tunnels is disputed: several warriors said it was their first meso-negative map; ranged classes report profit.

picks.why: Zombie and Horny Mushrooms, the classic 21 to 30 map.
Has a shop on the map, so refills cost no walking.
Ant Tunnel with Evil Eyes mixed in.
Stirges with mushrooms.

picks.map: The Land of Wild Boar II
picks.why: The alternative for warriors and crossbowmen.

tips: Jr. Wraiths need roughly 82 accuracy to hit reliably.

picks.why: Jr. Wraiths under Kerning, the densest map for the range. Best for clerics.
Fire Boars, weak to ice: best for ice and lightning magicians; warriors and bowmen do well too.
Lorangs at 36 to 40, best with lightning.
Ligators, Horny Mushrooms and Jr. Neckis at 30 to 36. One of the densest early-30s maps.

picks.map: A Look-Out Shed Around the Beach
picks.why: Lorangs at 36 to 42, weak to lightning. One portal from potions.

tips: The Wraith lines are a long walk from Kerning City: carry plenty of potions.
Wraiths hit hard: clerics turn Magic Guard on here.

picks.why: Zombie Lupins at 41 to 45: undead, low defense, good drops. Clerics love it.
Wraiths from about 46.
Ice and lightning magicians report strong party rates.
Torties.
Jr. Wraiths and Wraiths at 44 to 55. Top Victoria Island map for the range in two guides.

picks.map: The Tunnel That Lost Light I
picks.why: Cold Eyes and Drakes at 40 to 46. Long walk, few players. Cold Eyes are weak to fire.

tips: Sleepy Dungeon V is disputed: one database ranks it first, players and spawn data favor other maps, and its spawns were lowered at launch.

picks.why: Maladies and Zombie Lupins; strong for thieves and melee from 55.
The new Excavation Site tombs.
Wraiths are still the densest fallback.
Clangs at 47 to 55, the Wraith alternative. Lightning magicians do best.
Crocos at 52 to 58. Weak to fire, resist ice; need about 101 accuracy.
Stone Golems at 55 to 62. Small maps, fine for a duo.

tips: Every source calls this range thin: slow respawns, and some maps are held by groups or bots.

picks.why: Wild Kargos at 58 to 68 when the Drake maps are crowded. Need about 117 accuracy.
Red Drakes. Slow respawns.
Tauromacis and Taurospear. Slow respawns.

economy: HP costs about half a meso per HP: Meat and Red Potions are the best value. MP costs about one meso per MP: Lemons, or Pure Water bought on the Free Market.
Cake restores 100 HP and 100 MP for 150 mesos: the best NPC item for both.
White and Blue Potions are poor value. Unagi, Pure Water and Elixirs are often cheaper on the Free Market than at the NPC.
Citizenship from level 12 (Henesys or Kerning): 5% to 25% off shops and taxis, plus Supreme Sniper Potions or Wolbis.
Monsters at 10 to 30 drop more potions in Classic.
Magicians: put 3 points in Magic Guard to unlock Magic Armor. Keep it off while grinding, on for bosses and Wraiths.
Ice-weak: Fire Boar, Copper Drake, Red Drake, Tauromacis. Ice-resistant: Ligator, Cold Eye, Drake, Croco. Lightning-weak: Iron Hog, Lorang, Clang.
Most mid-level monsters give 5 to 10% less EXP than old GMS and have a little more avoid.
party: Kerning PQ: level 21+, no upper limit in Classic, party of 4, 30 minutes, three players can finish. Most guides say party grinding gives more EXP.
Party EXP bonus: sources disagree. Reported from +10% for 2 members up to 30% or more for 4 to 6.
To share EXP you must be on the map and have attacked, been hit or used a skill in the last 10 seconds.
Mesos are split in a party, not increased.
